description_en: Updates the properties of a private CA certificate, such as the export status
kebab_example: aliyun cas update-pca-certificate --alias-name cert-name --identifier 160ae6bb538d538c70c01f81dcf20000 --tags Value=test Key=runtime --resource-group-id rg-ae0000004wia --client-token XXX --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePcaCertificate

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the CA certificate.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328095.html to query the unique identifiers of all CA certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的CA证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/328095.html查询所有CA证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value to make sure that it is unique among different requests. The token can be a maximum of 64 ASCII characters and cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The error details of the authorization

AuthAction.description_en: The unauthorized operation that you attempted to perform
AuthAction.description_zh: 尝试执行的未授权操作

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en:
The identity that is used for authorization in the request. Valid values:

RAM user: UID of the RAM user

RAM role: RoleName:RoleSessionName

Federated user: ProviderType/ProviderName
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh:
请求中用于鉴权的身份标识。具体取值为：
RAM 用户：RAM 用户 UID
RAM 角色：RoleName:RoleSessionName
Federated：ProviderType/ProviderName

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authorized principal belongs

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The complete diagnostic information that is encrypted
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 加密后的完整诊断信息

NoPermissionType.description_en: The reason why the authorization failed. Valid values: ExplicitDeny: The authorization is explicitly denied. ImplicitDeny: The authorization is implicitly denied
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
导致鉴权失败的原因。具体取值为：
ExplicitDeny：显示拒绝
ImplicitDeny：隐式拒绝
